Name: Launch
Description: Runs commands, shows live status on keys and dials, and switches to its generated profiles. Keys are generated by development-tools-bootstrap/streamdeck/generate.py; there is no property inspector.
Author: Jonathan Leek

Actions.Name: Run command
Actions.Tooltip: Run the argv in this key's settings.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: Live view of the source in this key's settings.

Actions.Name: Status dial
Actions.Tooltip: Live view of the source in this dial's settings on the touch strip.

Actions.Name: Switch page
Actions.Tooltip: Show a page of one of this plugin's profiles, or go back.
